name: – Riho Terras – § 6 – Am 4
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Kosovo
part_text: 6. Stresses that the non-recognition of Kosovo by five EU Member States constitutes a major obstacle to Kosovo’s EU accession process; underlines that the right to recognise an entity as a state, in terms of international law, is a fundamental element of state sovereignty; firmly rejects the pressure exerted by the EU on these five Member States;
